context.paragraph: Recordings distinguish completed, error, and limited outcomes. Both stdout and stderr are captured in event snapshots and final results. Runtime diagnostics are appended to final stderr and displayed with stdout in the Inspector’s program output, rather than the floating UI error label. Compilation diagnostics instead open the source editor and mark the offending source location, including rejected AST constructs and imports. Editing clears stale diagnostics. Exceptions followed by frame termination are labeled unwind rather than a successful return of None. Syntax errors produce no execution events. tools/capture.py#run launches a fresh native subprocess and applies a parent-enforced timeout; it is a local development tool, not an untrusted-code sandbox.
